description: The file defines the 'Contextual' class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. This class encapsulates contextual information about messages processed by actors in an Akka-based system, including message headers, sender/receiver references, timers, logging, and security-related flags. It serves as a core component for message handling and context management within the enforcement services of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Contextual
classes.description: A class that encapsulates contextual information about a message within an actor, including message data, sender/receiver references, timers, logging, entity identification, and authorization flags. It provides methods to access and modify the context in message processing workflows.

methods.name: forActor
methods.description: Creates a new Contextual instance for an actor with specified actor references, timeout, logger, and response receiver cache.

methods.name: withAskFuture
methods.description: Returns a new Contextual instance with the specified ask-future for message forwarding.

methods.name: getMessageOptional
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the message if present.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message, throwing an exception if it is null.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef of the sender.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the message, derived from the message content or a default.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders from the message, or an empty header set if message is null.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders of the message, returning the modified message.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Creates a new Contextual with a different message.

methods.name: getAskFuture
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ask future if present.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef representing the current actor.

methods.name: getPubSubMediator
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the publish/subscribe mediator.

methods.name: getConciergeForwarder
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef used for forwarding messages to the concierge.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration used for ask pattern timeouts.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the logging adapter used in this context.

methods.name: getEntityIdWithResourceType
methods.description: Returns the entity ID with resource type; throws if null.

methods.name: getStartedTimer
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timer if set.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the receiver ActorRef, if set.

methods.name: getReceiverWrapperFunction
methods.description: Returns the receiver wrapper function, defaulting to identity if none set.

methods.name: getResponseReceivers
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the response receivers cache if set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Returns whether the context indicates authorization changes.

methods.name: tryToMapMessage
methods.description: Attempts to map the message to a new message via provided function, returning an Optional.

methods.name: withReceivedMessage
methods.description: Creates a new Contextual instance with a received message and sender.

methods.name: withTimer
methods.description: Returns a new Contextual with a specified timer.

methods.name: withReceiver
methods.description: Returns a new Contextual with a specified receiver.

methods.name: withReceiverWrapperFunction
methods.description: Returns a new Contextual with a specified receiver wrapper function.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Returns a new Contextual with altered authorization change flag.
